variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, medium tall, medium slender grain variety developed by BAU, Sabour. Released in 2014 for medium irrigated lowland segments of Bihar. It matures in about 130-135 days and has high HRR. Tolerant to lodging and major diseases and insect pests.
